parameters.name: AlarmName
parameters.description: The name of the quota usage alert.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of records to return.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that specifies the start point of the query.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the query starts from the beginning.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> To obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

parameters.name: QuotaActionCode
parameters.description:
The quota ID.

> - To obtain the quota ID of an Alibaba Cloud service, see the `QuotaActionCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).
>
> - If you specify this parameter, you must also specify `ProductCode`.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of the quota dimension.

> - The number of key-value pairs that you can specify for the quota dimensions varies based on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If you set `ProductCode` to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and value for the quota dimension.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The value of the quota dimension.

> - The number of key-value pairs that you can specify for the quota dimensions varies based on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If you set `ProductCode` to `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, you must specify both the key and value for the quota dimension.
